notes: Founder's four-post LinkedIn series with an undisclosed client statement, three winning stock picks shown without the portfolios' overall results, and a guaranteed-sounding tax-harvesting benefit, against a fully disclosed third-party list recognition.

planted.span: A client couple let me share their note from last week: "Dana took a shoebox of statements from four different firms and turned it into one plan we finally understand. Hiring her team was the best financial decision we have made in retirement."
planted.explanation: A client statement is posted with only an informal indication of client status and no disclosure of whether the couple received compensation or of any material conflict of interest, here or in the standard disclosure.

planted.span: Three of the positions we added to client portfolios in early 2025 finished the year up 112%, 74% and 58%: Quillon Grid Systems, Tamsworth Biologics and Arnbeck Freight.
planted.explanation: Three selected winning positions are presented with their 2025 gains while the performance of the client portfolios they were drawn from is neither shown nor offered.

planted.span: Our tax-loss harvesting program adds at least 1.5% a year to every client's after-tax return, in up markets and down.
planted.explanation: A guaranteed minimum benefit for every client in all markets is an unsubstantiated statement of fact, and the post itself says harvesting applies only to taxable accounts and generally defers rather than eliminates tax.

decoys.span: In February 2026, Brenlow Adviser Quarterly named Fenwright Ostler to its list of 40 Independent Firms to Watch in the Mountain West, based on firm data for the period January 1 through December 31, 2025.
decoys.why_ok: The post gives the date, the period the list was based on, the unaffiliated rater that created and tabulated it, and the $2,400 licensing fee paid to use the designation.
